segments.text: V. 33. Our LORD here refers to the Promiſe made to the pure in heart, of ſeeing GOD in all things, and points out a falſe Doctrine of the Scribes, which aroſe from their not thus ſeeing GOD.

What he forbids is, The Swearing at all,
1. By any creature,
2. In our ordinary Converſation: Both of which the Scribes and Phariſees taught to be perfectly innocent.
